analysis.action_line: VIX 19.94 Normal + S5FI 53.7% breadth + Nikkei -3.85% suggests global weakness, trade RS leaders cautiously near support.
analysis.analysis_para1: Global markets are broadly lower today, with the Nikkei 225 leading the decline at a steep -3.85%, followed by the FTSE 100 at -1.41% and the DAX at -0.74%. This pervasive international weakness is clearly spilling over into U.S. equities, particularly impacting the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100. While the BAML HY Spread is currently unknown, preventing a clear assessment of the credit regime, U.S. equity breadth measures show a nuanced picture. The S5FI (stocks > 50DMA) is holding above the critical 50% threshold at 53.7%, while the MMTH (stocks > 200DMA) remains robust at 61.3%, indicating underlying longer-term strength despite today's selling pressure.
analysis.analysis_para2: The ongoing sell-off, with the S&P 500 down -1.34% and Nasdaq 100 down -2.53%, necessitates close monitoring of key technical support levels. For the S&P 500, a hold above the 7250-7275 range is crucial to prevent an acceleration of distribution. The Nasdaq 100, which has absorbed a significant hit, needs to maintain above the 28500 level to avert further downside toward 28000. Our mechanical plan involves observing price action at these thresholds: a bounce on diminishing volume would be constructive, whereas heavy volume selling below support warrants increased caution and defensive positioning.
analysis.technical_signal: No reversal pattern confirmed yet. The indices are currently extending their daily declines without clear signs of accumulation or exhaustion.
